title: Cảnh bậc nâng cấp tầng mây, đợt 2: viền / lối riêng từng bậc, vật mốc phụ, điểm nhấn bậc 5, 9 sinh vật, đèn, hạt bay
decisions: Decision 056 second wave (owner: too few assets). Rank variants replace the previous rank look (border r3-r5, path r3-r5, lanterns r5), per-tier extras: landmark_NN_b (rank 4, companion piece), accent_NN (rank 5, large, 320x360), critters 02-10 (critter_01 is the first batch). Particles are tiny single sprites that the game drifts by code (petal, firefly). Themes follow vi.cloud.tierNames order.
